messages:
raj: quick FYI — canary traffic for /v1/generate (dedicated canary) started failing SDK e2e. Error shows when response includes "alternatives": [] instead of null. Thoughts? @anna
anna: uh oh. can you paste the response and content-type?
michael: :eyes: pinging infra if this is a deploy-related regression
raj: sure, snippet below
```json
{"id":"r1","text":"ok","alternatives":[]}
```
Also headers: `content-type: application/json` from runtime. SDK code path expects `alternatives` null for single result and treats [] as multi-result; it throws when array length==0.
michael: wait, why would runtime produce empty array? model scoring code should return null when no alternatives. Did the recent structured-output sanitizer change touch this?
raj: suspect change in structured-output sanitizer — it normalizes missing fields to empty arrays for array-typed fields. Canary shows ~1.2% failure rate on users with older SDKs.
sarah: we have two options: 1) make runtime revert to null for empty alternatives; 2) change SDK to treat empty array as null-compatible. Which is lower risk?
anna: short-term SDK patch is easy and backward-compatible. Long-term runtime should follow schema. Propose: roll SDK patch to accept [] as null, then deploy runtime fix next week.
michael: agree. I'll open PR for SDK (client-js) with a simple coercion and unit tests. Will tag canary. @deploy-bot can we fast-track?
deploy-bot: deploy request received for PR #4123. CI pending. ETA ~20m once green.
raj: thanks. Also quick note: structured-output content-type header sometimes missing for streaming responses which causes some clients to fallback to text/plain; will add a small smoke test to catch that.
anna: filed a mini-ticket: INF-987 add schema assertion in runtime smoke checks + SDK resilience tests. Assigning to @michael and @raj. :+1:
michael: on it. I'll also add regression test for `alternatives: []` -> SDK returns empty list, not error.
raj: nice. tagging this as a canary postmortem follow-up. closing thread after deploy green. :shipit:
